name: Summit AZ - Design and Readability Fixes 2026-09-10
body:
> Report · Summit Az · 2026-09-10

# Summary
Rollup of the Sep 10, 2026 design and readability fixes made after the relaunch, with their per-page CSVs and the follow-up recrawl request. All work was done in Elementor page data with server backups; no copy, SEO settings or the homepage were changed.

# Card box fix (`Summit-AZ-Card-Box-Fix-2026-09-10.md` and `.csv`)
- Reference design: /drain-cleaning/ (page 4758). On /water-softeners/ the navy sat on an inner box, cards had a 0px gutter and 36px headings overflowed.
- Fix: navy #042B4B moved to the full-width section, 20px gutter, 2 columns tablet and 1 mobile, card headings 24px, body 16px.
- Audit of 165 pages found 22 more with the problem (13 service pages promoted to full-width navy; 10 leak detection city pages kept their panel but got padding, radius and gutter). Re-audit: no card row left with a 0px gutter or overflow.
- Open: Scott to confirm 11 sections whose colour changed from bright blue or near-black to navy.

# Invisible text fix (`Summit-AZ-Invisible-Text-Report-2026-09-10.md` and `Summit-AZ-Invisible-Text-Audit-2026-09-10.csv`)
- All 200 pages scanned for rendered text vs background contrast (WCAG ratio under 2.0 treated as invisible). 71 pages had 279 invisible text blocks (dark on navy or teal, near-black on near-black, off-white on white, brand blue on blue).
- All fixed; re-scan found zero. Backups `~/contrast-backup-20260910/` and a full Elementor snapshot.
- Open: "0% Financing Available" became visible on /free-tankless-quote-v2/ and -v3/; Scott to confirm the offer is current.

# GSC recrawl (`Summit-AZ-GSC-Recrawl-2026-09-10.md`)
- All 23 card-fixed pages submitted via Request Indexing, no quota block. Found three service pages missing from the index: /plumbing-repair/ (crawled not indexed), /faucet-and-toilet-plumbing-services/ and /shower-bath-repair-installation-services/ (discovered not indexed).

# Other small files
- `Summit-AZ-Change-Tracker-2026-09-10.csv` and `Summit-AZ-Design-Changes-2026-09-10.csv`: about 171 URLs with which design, readability, card, H1, hero, FAQ, icon, footer-link and Areas We Serve fixes each received.
- `Summit-AZ-Dead-Link-Check-2026-09-10.csv`: 35 checked links with status and verdict.
- `Summit-AZ-Repiping-Service-Areas-2026-09-10.txt`: /repiping/ got the approved 10-button service area block linking to general plumbing city pages; no lead form because repiping is not an approved service.
